name: shadcn/ui snippets
summary: Deprecated VS Code snippet extension for importing and using shadcn-ui components in JSX/TSX files.
description: Type cn or shadcn in a jsx/tsx file and choose from snippets: cni-[component] adds imports, cnx-[component] adds JSX, cnp-[component] adds page-level components. The listing is marked deprecated in favor of the shadcn/next extension (nrjdalal.shadcn-ui-next); calendar, combobox, data table, date picker and toast were still to be added.
contains: snippets generated from markdown component files
calendar, combobox, data table, date picker and toast not yet covered
